name: application-details-list
title: Details Lists
description: Responsive details list components for displaying structured data with striped rows, borders, and dark mode support for web applications and dashboards.
useWhen: Responsive details list components for displaying structured data with striped rows, borders, and dark mode support for web applications and dashboards.
avoidWhen: Avoid details lists when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Details Lists uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
